plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Sangoma Vega voice gateway. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory, temperature, and interface traffic, for Dialogic IMG 2020 (enterprise PEN 3028).
name: VoiceGateway

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports Dialogic IMG 2020 CPU busy as a whole percent from the cpu info table (IANA PEN 3028), walked by cpuInfoIndex and mapped as cpu_usage_percent. Values are already 0-100 percentages. The query takes the maximum across CPU indexes so the busiest CPU is visible. Sustained high CPU usage can affect call processing and management responsiveness.

metrics.name: memory_free_bytes
metrics.description: This metric reports Dialogic IMG 2020 free memory in bytes from the cpu info table (IANA PEN 3028). The table has no total-memory column, so memory utilization percent is not derived. The query takes the minimum across CPU indexes so a duplicated chassis reading is not summed. A falling free-memory reading can indicate a leak or overload.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports Dialogic IMG 2020 temperature in degrees Celsius from the temperature location table (IANA PEN 3028), walked by temperatureLocationIndex. An optional location name tag identifies the sensor. High temperature can indicate cooling or airflow problems.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
